purpose: $abstime read back at every accepted point equals that point's time, across rejected attempts.

oracle.derivation: LRM 9.10: $abstime is the absolute time in seconds. The model is a pure voltage source of that value, so at an accepted row v(ta) == t identically. N2 forces rejected-and-retried steps at t = 0.125, 0.375, 0.625, 0.875; per LRM 8.4.7 the engine cannot advance past an unaccepted solution, so no accepted row may carry the time of a rejected trial point.
